verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents official language support (JS/TS/Python/Rust), a CLI (Wrangler), exposed OpenAPI spec, llms.txt for AI-agent consumption, and native MCP server support for building agents — strong signals for AI-native SDK usage. However, community evidence disputes practical completeness (no full Node runtime, limited/no real Python support, vendor lock-in on KV/D1), tempering the 'official SDK' story.
